android.desc:
Breath Companion is the complete interactive guide for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity. Explore Hyrule with a detailed offline map, track every collectible with smart checklists, and look up any item, armor, weapon or enemy in seconds.

INTERACTIVE OFFLINE MAP
The whole of Hyrule, including both DLC packs. All map data works without an internet connection once downloaded.
- Sheikah towers, shrines and shrine quests
- Korok seeds with the solution for each puzzle
- Treasure chests, including DLC chests
- Main quests, side quests and memories
- Dragons, Guardians, Talus, Hinox and Molduga
- Great Fairy fountains, stables, shops and villages
- Enemy camps, wizzrobes, cooking pots and rafts
- Filter by type, region or completion state, and search the whole map instantly

CHECKLISTS AND PROGRESS TRACKING
Tick off shrines, koroks, quests, memories, treasures and more, straight from the map. Group and sort entries the way you like and watch your completion percentage climb.

COMPLETE GAME DATABASES
- Compendium with all creatures, monsters, materials, equipment and treasure
- Armor sets with defense values, set bonuses and full upgrade material lists
- Weapons, bows and shields with attack, durability and where to find them
- Enemies with health, attacks, drops and locations
- Recipes and elixirs with the exact ingredients and effects
- Trial of the Sword floor-by-floor guides
- Amiibo rewards and horse and dog rewards

AGE OF CALAMITY
Track your progress through the Warriors spin-off alongside the main game.

SYNC AND BACKUP
You can export and import a backup file, or move progress to another device with a sync code.

MADE FOR PLAYERS
- Works fully offline, so it is ready even without a connection
- Light and dark theme with several accent styles
- Available in 20 languages
- Optional ad-free unlock

DISCLAIMER
Breath Companion is a third-party, unofficial companion app. The developer is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Nintendo Co., Ltd. The Legend of Zelda, Breath of the Wild, Hyrule Warriors and all related names are trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd. All game content is used under fair use guidelines.
